zh-CN.name: Archify
zh-CN.shortDesc: 把代码库或系统描述编译成可交互的系统架构图（架构/流程/时序/数据流/生命周期），产出自带动效、可校验、可导出的单文件 HTML/SVG，适配 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。需可用的 Node.js 环境；浏览器验证和导出须满足上游运行要求。

en-US.name: Archify
en-US.shortDesc: Compile a codebase or system description into interactive, verifiable architecture/workflow/sequence/data-flow/lifecycle diagrams — self-contained HTML/SVG with motion and crisp export, for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Requires Node.js and the upstream browser verification/export prerequisites.
